Variants.Content: Entry The Kingsguard are the seven white knights who protect the king and his close relatives. They gave up marriage, inheritance rights and original vassal obligations, and exchanged lifelong vows for the honor closest to royal power; the white robe was therefore both an honor and a severed chain from the family. Entry Kingsguard For the nobles, the white robe is a path where the family may lose an heir; for the little people, it is a legend that a few people can stand beside the throne.
